text:
Marco Chen: folks, can we get a lightweight roll-up dashboard that links SM/MIG slice usage to token-level SLOs per-route? seeing sniffy latencies on route /chat-gen today and want correlations.
Alex Rivera: yeah. which signals do you care about first? SM occupancy, VRAM, power, temps, MIG slice count?
Marco Chen: all of the above but prioritize sm_occupancy, vram_used_gb, mig_slice_active, gpu_power_w, gpu_temp_c and token_latency_p50/p95. also kv_cache_hit_rate per-route.
Priya Nair: agree. also add kernel_selector_fallback_count and kernel_choice_latency_ms so we can spot selector regressions.
Sam Patel: I can sketch PromQL panels. quick mock: `avg_over_time(sm_occupancy{gpu!=""}[5m])` for slice-level occupancy, `max(vram_used_bytes)/1024/1024/1024` for GB.
Alex Rivera: pinging infra: would prefer derived metric `route_token_tail_ms{route="/chat-gen"}` from our token-level tracing pipeline. that feeds token latency waterfall panels.
Lina (perf-bot): uploaded artifact: https://ci.internal/redwood/perf/artifacts/1812345600/prof.zip (profiles + kernel traces). It flagged a kernel-selector jump at commit d3f4a9e.
Marco Chen: thanks Lina. @Sam can you add a panel that overlays `kernel_selector_fallback_count` with `token_latency_p95` (same GPU pool) to show causality?
Sam Patel: yep. rough PromQLs I plan to use:
```
sum by(gpu_pool) (rate(kernel_selector_fallback_total[5m]))
avg by(gpu_pool,route) (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, gpu_pool, route)))
```
Priya Nair: for KV cache: `kv_cache_hit_rate{route="/chat-gen"}` and prefix cache hit counts. where do we store per-route KV metrics?
Alex Rivera: they're emitted from runtime with label `route`. should be in perf-prod metrics. I think the exporter uses `kv_cache_hit_total` and `kv_cache_miss_total`. derive hit_rate = hits/(hits+misses).
Jules: small UX ask: can the dashboard show per-MIG slice breakdown (slice0..slice7) and a condensed rollup for the whole GPU? ops wants both granularity and exec-level summary.
Sam Patel: done. plan panels: 6 small ones in a row: SM occupancy per slice, VRAM GB, GPU power (W), GPU temp (C), kernel fallback rate, token p95. drilldown link to route detail.
Marco Chen: what about alerts? i'd like an alert when token_p95 > 250ms AND sm_occupancy < 20% (indicates underutilized with high latency).
Priya Nair: add watchdog: if kv_cache_hit_rate drops > 10% relative to baseline AND token_p95 rises > 15%, send page to eng-runtime on-call.
Alex Rivera: should also annotate graphs with deploys: `deploy-bot` events. adds context for regressions.
Lina (perf-bot): added deploy annotations and a synthetic query to show recent model variant rollouts.
Sam Patel: implementation steps:
- create Grafana dashboard (uid: TODO)
- panels + PromQLs, attach route filter variable
- add alert rules for the two thresholds
- wire dashboards to incident runbook (link in panel)
Marco Chen: timeframe? can we get a first pass by EOD tomorrow? this is high priority for the `/chat-gen` regression.
Sam Patel: EOD tomorrow is tight but I can do a first pass (no polish).
Priya Nair: i'll prepare a short eval script to replay traces with KV cache on/off to reproduce kv-hit impact.
Jules: i'll coordinate with SRE to ensure MIG slice metrics are exposed from the new 4090 fleet.
Alex Rivera: noted. also add a small table panel with per-route QPS and active sessions so we don't confuse load spikes.
Marco Chen: awesome. thanks all — please post dashboard link here when ready and include quick checklist in the panel description. :thumbsup:
Lina (perf-bot): reminder: profiling artifact contains kernel traces + nvprof samples; sampler shows heavy memcpy at 2026-11-08T14:22Z.
Sam Patel: acknowledging, will correlate memcpy hotspots with VRAM churn and kernel selection.
Marco Chen: action items summary: Sam - draft dashboard + alerts; Priya - replay eval; Jules - MIG metric enable; Alex - tie deploy annotations and route variables. I'll follow up after first pass.
Alex Rivera: small follow-up: add `kv_prefetch_latency_ms` if we can emit it; that often explains tail spikes.
Priya Nair: good call. will add to eval and metric wishlist.
Marco Chen: closing thread for now, will reopen if first-pass shows any red flags. :rocket:
